lessons_learned.title: P-L10 — In this codebase, `req.params.foo` types as `string | string[]` and breaks Drizzle `eq()`
lessons_learned.summary:
**Symptom:** Compiling `server/foster-youth-agency-routes.ts` failed with TS2769 ("No overload matches this call") on calls like `eq(table.id, agencyId)` after destructuring `const { agencyId } = req.params;`.

**Root cause:** Express's typings are widened in this project so `req.params` is `Record<string, string | string[]>`. Drizzle's `eq()` overloads do not accept `string | string[]`.

**Fix:** Always coerce before passing to Drizzle column comparisons OR insert values:
```ts
const agencyId = String(req.params.agencyId);
await db.select().from(agencies).where(eq(agencies.id, agencyId));
```

lessons_learned.title: P-L11 — When the audit report uses Markdown bold (`**FAIL:**`), brittle `/FAIL:\s*\d+/` regexes silently miss
lessons_learned.summary:
**Symptom:** PPTX generator's safety gate ("refuse to publish if any FAIL") was triggered with `FAIL_COUNT = 999` (the safe-default) even after a clean 175/175 PASS audit.

**Root cause:** `scripts/congruence-audit.ts` writes the verdict as `- **PASS:** 175 / 175` / `- **FAIL:** 0`. The PPTX gate's regex `/FAIL:\s*(\d+)/` did not allow for the leading `**` from Markdown bolding, so it didn't match → fell through to the safe default of 999.

**Fix:** Make the regex tolerant of optional Markdown bold: `/FAIL:\*?\*?\s*(\d+)/`. Or — better — parse the audit JSON if/when the auditor emits one.

foster_youth_build_log.heading: Foster Youth Aging Out experience (built May 11, 2026 for Jim Currier visit; expanded same day)
foster_youth_build_log.body:
- **8 pages under `client/src/pages/foster-youth/`**: `hub.tsx` (`/foster-youth`) · `toolkit.tsx` · `transition-plan.tsx` · `wellbeing.tsx` (PHQ-2 + GAD-2 + housing/food, crisis routing on red flags) · `rights.tsx` (federal + Texas, every entry shows the legal source) · `benefits.tsx` (50 states + DC sourced from `client/src/data/foster-youth/state-ilp.ts`, Texas full-detail) · **`intake.tsx`** (live AI-assisted 4-step wizard: basics → checklist → document upload → personalized 30/60/90 plan) · **`cohort-analytics.tsx`** (admin dashboard segments intakes/documents/events so each user has a data story). Bilingual EN/ES, no login on public pages, localStorage persistence. Crisis routing (988/741741/1-800-RUNAWAY) on every page via shared `client/src/components/foster-youth/crisis-strip.tsx`. Routes in `client/src/App.tsx`; sidebar group "Youth Aging Out of Foster Care" in `client/src/components/app-sidebar.tsx` (`fosterYouthItems`).
- **Intake backend:** `server/foster-youth-intake-routes.ts` — POST /api/foster-youth/intake creates a draft and returns a per-intake **capability `accessToken`** (server-generated; client-supplied id is ignored) · PATCH /api/foster-youth/intake/:id (token-gated) · POST .../upload-url (token-gated, type/size-validated, doc count capped at 10/intake, 15MB/file, PDF/JPEG/PNG/HEIC/WebP only) · POST .../document (token-gated) · POST .../analyze (token-gated AND per-IP rate-limited to 5 / 10 min for non-privileged; Anthropic Haiku 4.5 → Replit-OpenAI gpt-5-nano → OpenAI gpt-4o-mini fallback) · POST /api/foster-youth/event (rate-limited 200/10min/IP) · GET /api/foster-youth/cohort-analytics (admin/case-manager/teacher only). Token sent via `x-intake-token` header (or `?token=`); admin/teacher/case_manager role bypasses the token. Client persists `{id, token}` to localStorage as `foster-youth-intake-credentials`. DB tables: `foster_youth_intakes` (incl. `accessToken` column, never returned in responses), `foster_youth_intake_documents`, `foster_youth_events` in `shared/schema.ts`.
- **State catalog:** `client/src/data/foster-youth/state-ilp.ts` — all 50 states + DC with verified official agency URLs. Phone/coordinator fields BLANK where unverified (no conjecture). ~15 states have statute-cited extras (CA THP-Plus, FL PESS, KY/MA/NC/OK/OR/PA/VA tuition waivers, MI Fostering Futures, WA Passport, etc.).
- **FAFSA foster mode**: `/fafsa-navigator?audience=foster` shows an Independent-Student + ETV callout. Root testid is `page-fafsa-navigator` (renamed from `fafsa-navigator` for audit consistency).
- **Federal coverage mapped & cited**: Chafee (42 USC §677), ETV (§677(i)), HUD FYI (24 CFR §982 youth set-aside), ACA §2004 Medicaid-to-26, FAFSA Independent (HEA §480(d)), McKinney-Vento, RHYA, plus Texas PAL/Extended FC/ID waiver/Tuition waiver.

foster_youth_build_log.heading: National Foster-Youth Agency Portal + Policy Comparison + Leave-Behind PPTX (May 11, 2026 — built for Jim Currier visit, post-intake expansion)
foster_youth_build_log.body:
- **Two pages, both auth-correct, both bilingual-page-shell** (CrisisStrip on each):
  - `/foster-youth/state-portal` — `client/src/pages/foster-youth/state-portal.tsx`. **Privileged-only** (admin / case_manager / teacher). Tabs: Caseload (recharts stratification + filterable case table + per-case dialog with risk breakdown + ISS-style stakeholder loop), Upload CSV (≤5,000 rows / 2MB; sample CSV via `GET /api/foster-youth/agency/sample-csv` is public), Agencies (create + list), Method & Sources (every risk factor cited).
  - `/foster-youth/policy-comparison` — `client/src/pages/foster-youth/policy-comparison.tsx`. Public read-only. Federal-floor disclosure, two-state side-by-side, "what's working" national rollup, full all-state matrix. Honest "Unverified" marking for any statute we have not confirmed (no conjecture). Roadmap card explicitly disclaims the 30-year longitudinal model (NDACAN micro-data ≈18-month approval).
- **Risk engine (deterministic, transparent, sourced):** `server/foster-youth-risk.ts` — pure `scoreCase(case)` returns `{score, tier, factors[]}` with each factor carrying `id, label, points, citation, sourceUrl`. Sources: Midwest Study (Chapin Hall), NYTD, Casey, Vera, AAP, NWGFCE, CSSP, True Colors United, IDEA §300.43. Tiers: 0–19 Stable · 20–39 Watch · 40–59 Elevated · 60+ Critical. **Tiers describe urgency of system response, never deficit in the youth.** `recommendedStakeholders(tier)` produces the ISS-style coordination loop.
- **Server routes:** `server/foster-youth-agency-routes.ts` — `requirePrivileged` (admin/case_manager/teacher) on every endpoint except sample CSV. Endpoints: list/create agencies; list cases (with tier filter); per-agency stratification stats; create one case; **bulk CSV upload** (parsed inline — no `papaparse` dep needed; quoted fields handled; size + row caps enforced server-side); get one case + stakeholders. Score is **always** recomputed server-side and is never user-editable. Registered in `server/routes.ts`.
- **Schema:** `shared/schema.ts` — added `fosterYouthAgencies`, `fosterYouthAgencyCases` (de-identified — no name/SSN/address/DOB; only `externalCaseId` + age in years), `fosterYouthCaseEvents`. `riskScore`/`riskTier`/`riskFactors` are `omit()`ed from the insert schema and computed server-side. `db:push --force` clean.
- **State-policy data:** `client/src/data/foster-youth/state-policies.ts` — 50 + DC. Policy dimensions: Extended Care to 21, public-college tuition waiver, transitional housing, monthly stipend, state ID-fee waiver. EFC populated for ~41 states from the Children's Bureau participation table; tuition-waiver/etc. populated only with statute citation + source URL — every other field is `active: null` ("Unverified") on purpose. `FEDERAL_FLOOR_NOTE` re-asserts ACA §2004 / Chafee / ETV / FAFSA Independent / FYI / McKinney-Vento / RHYA apply uniformly.
- **Sidebar:** new items in `client/src/components/app-sidebar.tsx` "Youth Aging Out of Foster Care" group: "State-Agency Portal" (Building2) and "Policy Comparison (50 states)" (Scale).
- **Congruence:** `docs/grants/CONGRUENCE-MANIFEST.json` v2 adds FY-019 (state-portal) and FY-020 (policy-comparison). **`npx tsx scripts/congruence-audit.ts` → 175/175 PASS, 0 FAIL** (May 11, 2026 post-build).
- **Leave-behind PPTX + Executive Briefing (generated LAST from live system):** `scripts/generate-foster-youth-pptx.ts` — refuses to run if audit shows any FAIL; reads CONGRUENCE-MANIFEST as source-of-truth. Outputs: `dist/Foster-Youth-Leave-Behind.pptx` (≈210KB, 17 slides — cover, evidence, honest disclosure, ecosystem, 11 surface slides, risk-method deep-dive, policy deep-dive, ask, contact) and `docs/grants/Foster-Youth-Executive-Briefing.md` (≈10KB / 5–10 pages, claim-for-claim with the deck). Re-run: `npx tsx scripts/generate-foster-youth-pptx.ts`.

foster_youth_build_log.heading: Self-Audit Congruence System (use for every funder briefing)
foster_youth_build_log.body:
- **Iron rule:** Audio = video. A claim in a briefing must be clickable on a live URL and verifiable via a `data-testid`.
- **Manifest:** `docs/grants/CONGRUENCE-MANIFEST.json` — every claim → URL → required test IDs → evidence file.
- **Audit:** `npx tsx scripts/congruence-audit.ts` — fetches URLs, statically asserts test IDs exist (literal AND template-literal-aware), probes external URLs for 200 + keywords. Writes `.agents/congruence/last-run.md`. Exits non-zero on any FAIL.
- **E2E:** `npx playwright test tests/e2e/foster-youth-journey.spec.ts` walks hub → toolkit → transition-plan → wellbeing → rights → benefits.
- **Latest run (May 11, 2026, post-expansion):** 152/152 static congruence PASS + e2e walkthrough confirms hub/intake/benefits/cohort-analytics/FAFSA-foster all render correctly. Verdict: CONGRUENT.
- **Hardening applied post-architect-review:** query string preserved on internal probe; external keyword miss is FAIL not WARN; crisis routing + bilingual coverage proven on all 6 pages via shared `<CrisisStrip />`; test-id search SCOPED to each claim's `evidenceUrl` (+ optional `evidenceFiles[]`) — no more cross-file false positives.
- **Discipline:** Add a manifest entry BEFORE adding a claim to a briefing. No FAILs before any meeting. See lessons P-L04 + P-L05 in `.agents/skills/map-gap/lessons-learned.md`.
